findings.finding: The public implementation is Ichimoku-style but not standard displaced Ichimoku: senkou_a and senkou_b are contemporaneous rolling values and are not shifted 26 bars forward.
findings.decision: Preserve the public semantics as one explicit branch; standard displaced Ichimoku, if investigated, must be a separate preregistered descendant and not silently substituted.

findings.finding: The public implementation uses np.roll for prior Tenkan/Kijun, causing wrap-around at the first row.
findings.decision: Invalidate the first required lag row rather than accepting wrap-around.

findings.finding: Public fast_simulate enters at signal close and does not implement QROS Bid/Ask execution.
findings.decision: Public PnL is inadmissible. QROS entry occurs at the first executable quote strictly after signal close; BUY enters Ask and SELL enters Bid.

findings.finding: Session labels cannot be used until broker/source timezone and DST behavior are proven.
findings.decision: Initial discovery session is ALL only.
